entries.title: Vendor personnel non-solicitation
entries.summary: AtliQ shall not hire or engage, directly or indirectly, any Vendor personnel who performed Services under the Agreement during the term and for 12 months thereafter.
entries.quote: During the term and for twelve (12) months thereafter, AtliQ shall not hire or engage, directly or indirectly, any Vendor personnel who performed Services under this Agreement.

relatedClauses.quote: This Agreement commences on 10 November 2025 and continues for two (2) years, until 9 November 2027.

entries.notes: One-way restriction on AtliQ prohibiting direct or indirect hiring of Vendor personnel who performed Services, with a 30% placement fee for breach.

referencedButMissing.name: Work Orders
referencedButMissing.note: Work orders under Section 1.1 specifying project, roles, number of personnel, expected hours, and duration.

referencedButMissing.name: AtliQ and client security policies
referencedButMissing.note: Security policies referenced in Section 1.3 with which Vendor personnel must comply.
